title: A Run Workflow whose boot step exhausts its retries never finalizes
body: In run-workflow.ts the boot step.do sits outside the try/finally that destroys the container, and superviseRun has no try around supervisePass, so a boot that fails three times (startProcess/issueRunToken throw, 300s step timeout) errors the instance: the lease is not released, the run row stays running, the gateway token is not revoked and a keepAlive container may never be destroyed. The same escape exists for a watch step that exhausts OBSERVE_RETRIES. No test fails the boot past its retries.
